source.name: USDA, ICMR–NIN, CoFID and named food references
source.basis: Calculated per-serving estimates from raw/cooked ingredient references, named product labels and explicitly disclosed reference recipes. All oil and whole dried lime are counted; cooking losses and retention are not modelled. Brand and piece-size assumptions are shown for each ingredient.

pita.note: USDA large pita, 60 g per piece (60 g per pieces). Actual sizes vary.

lentils.note: Generic dry lentils; red variety not separately specified.

lemon.note: USDA juice yield: 48 g per lemon; peel not included (48 g per lemons). Actual sizes vary.

oil.note: Density from USDA tablespoon (13.5 g); US customary volume 14.78676 ml.

rice.note: Generic dry long-grain white rice used for basmati.

bzar.note: Reference blend by weight: cumin 15, coriander 10, fenugreek 24, fennel 15, black pepper 10, cinnamon 5, cardamom 5, red chilli 5, turmeric 6 g. Optional nutmeg/ginger omitted; turmeric 2 USDA tsp × 3 g. USDA ground cinnamon/red pepper represent ground whole spices. A calculated home-blend estimate, not a verified retail bzar product.

brownlentils.note: Generic dry lentils; brown variety not separately specified.

poha.note: IFCT raw edible reference; energy converted from kJ ÷ 4.184. Carbs include reported dietary fibre.

moong.note: Generic dry mung beans used for split moong.

garam.note: Named spice-blend reference. Carbs = label carbohydrate 29 + fibre 40 g/100g; brand blend proportions vary.

regag.note: One piece is modelled as one of the 10 servings in the plain flour/water/salt reference recipe. This is a recipe estimate, not a packaged-regag label or a measured retail piece weight.

khameer.reason: Product nutrition label and edible piece weight needed.

labneh.note: Puck plain full-fat labneh reference, not plain yogurt; brands and fat levels vary.

milk.note: Whole milk, 3.25% fat. Density from USDA tbsp (15 g); US customary volume 14.78676 ml.

fishfillet.note: Atlantic cod used for unspecified white fish.

loomi.note: Sadaf whole dried-lime reference: 9 g per lime; package-rounded macros. The entire measured lime is counted even if removed after cooking, so retained nutrients can be lower.

beef.note: Lean top-sirloin beef used for unspecified lean strips.

zaatar.note: Named sesame/sumac/herb blend reference. Label carbs are retained as reported (fibre not supplied); different blends and added salt vary.

egg.note: USDA large egg, 50 g edible weight (50 g per eggs). Actual sizes vary.

pepper.note: Green bell pepper used for unspecified colour.

wraps.note: USDA 7–8 inch flour tortilla, 49 g per wrap (49 g per wraps). Actual sizes vary.

paneer.note: Full-fat paneer product reference, not Western cottage cheese. Homemade moisture and other brands vary.

emiratiLamb.note: Raw lamb shoulder, edible lean and fat; bone excluded.

full-salted-fish.reason: Species plus post-desalting edible yield/nutrition are needed. Salted dry cod cannot stand in for unspecified fish after soaking.

full-cracked-wheat.note: Generic dry hard white wheat used for cracked wheat.

vermicelli.note: Dry wheat somen noodles used for vermicelli.

bakingpowder.note: Generic double-acting straight-phosphate baking powder reference; not baking soda. Actual leavening formulations vary.

full-chicken-thigh.note: Raw chicken thigh meat; skin and bone excluded.

full-freekeh.note: Cracked dry green wheat reference, not cooked freekeh or bulgur. Energy kJ ÷ 4.184. Carbs follow the label (fibre not supplied).

full-lamb-chops.note: Raw bone-in loin-chop reference, lean and fat, weighed with bone. CoFID already adjusts edible yield; no second bone deduction. Other cuts/trimming vary.

full-mussels.note: CoFID raw mussel flesh with published edible proportion 0.32 for live in-shell mussels. 300 g in shell is modelled as 96 g raw edible flesh; actual/discarded-shell yields vary.

full-beef-steak.note: Lean top-sirloin used for unspecified steak.

full-seabream.note: CoFID raw edible flesh only. Excludes bones, head, scales and skin; not a canned or cooked-fish substitute.

full-wholewheat-bread.note: Generic whole-wheat bread nutrition; does not certify ingredient exclusions. USDA whole-wheat bread slice (32 g per slices). Actual sizes vary.

full-cream.note: Light cream used for unspecified cooking cream. Density from USDA tbsp (15 g); US customary volume 14.78676 ml.

bread.note: Generic commercial white bread. USDA white bread slice (29 g per slices). Actual sizes vary.

full-soysauce.note: Density from USDA tbsp (16 g); US customary volume 14.78676 ml.

tuna.note: Tuna canned in water, drained solids.

quality-soya.note: Dry defatted soy mince product reference. Per 23 g dry serving; water added during hydration adds no macros. Label-rounded zero fat is not an analytical zero.

quality-cooked-lentils.note: Cooked boiled lentils used for canned drained lentils.

quality-whitebeans.note: Canned white beans; drain level can vary.

target-sago.reason: Verified sago product label needed; tapioca is not the same ingredient.

target-oatmilk.note: Per 100 ml directly; no invented liquid density. Named unsweetened oat-drink reference; other products vary.

target-millet.note: Dry common-millet flakes reference, not generic dry millet grain or cooked porridge. Follow packet cooking instructions.

target-vineleaves.note: Canned grape leaves; drain level can vary.

target-blackeye.reason: Verified drained canned black-eyed bean record needed.

target-barleyflakes.note: Dry rolled barley flakes reference, not cooked barley; follow the cooking time on your packet.

target-ar-pomegranate.reason: A pure pomegranate-molasses label with all four macros AND the mass of a measured ml serving is needed; no assumed syrup density.

target-ar-pastry.note: Generic phyllo dough nutrition; does not certify ingredient exclusions.

target-ar-herring.note: Atlantic kippered herring reference: ready-to-eat smoked flesh, not fresh herring or pickled herring; brand and fat content vary.

target-ar-harissa.note: Vegan chilli-paste product reference, not dry harissa seasoning. Label carbs are retained as reported; oils/sugar in other brands vary.

target-ar-sardines.note: CoFID raw edible flesh only. Excludes bones, head, scales and skin; not a canned or cooked-fish substitute.

target-desi-noodles.note: Dry wheat somen noodles used for egg-free wheat noodles.

target-desi-vinegar.note: Density from USDA tbsp (14.9 g); US customary volume 14.78676 ml.

target-yeast.note: Active dry yeast used for instant yeast.
